2608.20274.title: Break It Down, Pass It On: Cross-Task Skill Transfer in LLM Agents
2608.20274.paper_summary: Large language model (LLM) agents can induce skills from completed tasks and reuse them later to grow more capable with experience. In practice, induced skills may transfer unreliably and can even harm the agent that retrieves them. When agent-induced skills transfer reliably across tasks remains an open question. We conduct a comprehensive and controlled study of how the way skills are induced shapes their transfer across tasks. Specifically, we compare task-level with subtask-level skill induction and text with code skill formats, the two axes along which existing methods differ. Task-level skills mostly reduce the agent's performance below its no-memory baseline while subtask-level skills raise it above on average, and text skills transfer better than code skills. To further understand our findings, we examine two complementary properties of the induced skills: specificity, which measures how closely a skill matches real tasks, and abstractness, which measures how evenly its relevance spreads across tasks. Neither property alone predicts task success, but their combined effect does, which we propose as a skill utility score. The score correlates consistently with task success when skills are transferred, and subtask-level and text skills score higher. Computing skill utility only needs the skills and task descriptions but not any task execution, so our score serves as a practical diagnostic of a skill memory before any new task runs.
2608.20274.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLM）代理可以從完成的任務中引導技能，並在以後重複使用這些技能以隨著經驗增長變得更有能力。<lb/>在實踐中，引導的技能可能會不可靠地轉移，甚至可能對檢索它們的代理造成傷害。<lb/>代理引導的技能在任務之間是否可靠轉移仍然是一個未解的問題。<lb/>我們進行了一項全面且受控的研究，探討技能的引導方式如何影響它們在任務之間的轉移。<lb/>具體而言，我們比較了任務級別與子任務級別的技能引導，以及文本與代碼技能格式，這是現有方法之間的兩個差異軸。<lb/>任務級別的技能通常將代理的性能降低到其無記憶基線以下，而子任務級別的技能則平均提高了性能，文本技能的轉移效果優於代碼技能。<lb/>為了進一步理解我們的發現，我們檢查了引導技能的兩個互補特性：特異性，衡量技能與實際任務的匹配程度，以及抽象性，衡量其相關性在任務之間的均勻分佈程度。<lb/>這兩個特性單獨都無法預測任務成功，但它們的綜合效果可以，這就是我們提出的技能效用得分。<lb/>當技能被轉移時，該得分與任務成功一致相關，而子任務級別和文本技能的得分更高。<lb/>計算技能效用只需要技能和任務描述，而不需要任何任務執行，因此我們的得分在任何新任務運行之前可以作為技能記憶的實用診斷。
